maddeler.e:
نتعايا (form VI)
# نَتَعَايَا (nataʕāyā) /na.ta.ʕaː.jaː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive of تَعَايَا (taʕāyā)
# نُتَعَايَا (nutaʕāyā) /nu.ta.ʕaː.jaː/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive of تَعَايَا (taʕāyā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
